name: BNB DEFI
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: A Rug Pull occurred in BNB DEFI, and the DEFI token fell by 68% in a short time. At present, the project has closed the community, and DEFI tokens have been exchanged for about 255 BNB.
